فَأَوتُ رَأْسَهُ * , inf. n. فَأْوٌ; and فَأَيتُهُ, inf. n. فَأْىٌ; I split, or clave, his head, i. e. a man's, with the sword: (AZ, T, S, M:) or I struck, or smote, the upper part of his skull so that it opened from over his brain. (Lth, T.) ― -b2- And فَأَيتُ القَدَحَ I split, or clave, or cracked, the bowl. (M.) And فَأَوتُهُ بِالعَصَا I smote, or struck, him with the staff, or stick. (IAar, M.) فَأْوٌ and فَأْىٌ both signify The act of smiting, or striking: and the act of splitting, or cleaving. (K.)
افأى * He (a man, TA) lighted upon, or became in, what is termed a فَأْو: or he inflicted a wound of the head such as showed the whiteness of the bone, or such as laid bare the bone. (K, TA.)
تَ1َ2َّ3َ see the next following paragraph.
انفأى * It became split, or cloven, (S, M, K,) or cracked; (M, K;) said of a bowl [&c.]; (S, M;) as also ↓ تفأّى: (M, TA:) it opened, or became opened: (M, K:) it opened so as to form a break, or breach: (T, M, K:) it became laid open, uncovered, or exposed to view. (T, TA.)
فَأْوٌ * An interval, (S, M,) or a low, or depressed, place, (خَفْض, so in one of my copies of the S,) between two mountains: (S, M:) and, accord. to Lh, (M,) a cleft (M, K) in a mountain, (M,) or between two mountains. (K.) And A وَطْء [or depressed tract], (M, and so in copies of the K,) or وَطِىْء, (so in other copies of the K,) meaning soft, or smooth, or plain, place, (TA,) between two stony tracts of the kind whereof one is termed حَرَّة. (M, K.) And, (M, K,) as some say, (M,) A clear, open, space among sands. (M, K.) And, (M, K,) accord. to As, (M,) A low, or depressed, tract of good land surrounded by mountains, (M, K,) and such as is of an elongated form, and such as is not of that form. (M.) And (as some say, TA) A narrow place in a valley, leading to a wide space, (K, TA,) of which the upper part has no place of exit. (TA.) And (as some say, TA) A smooth place. (K, TA.) ― -b2- Also The night; (M, K;) so says Aboo-Leylà but of questionable correctness. (M.) ― -b3- And The place, or time, of sunset. (K.)
فِيءَةٌ * A party, portion, division, or distinct body; or a company, or congregated body; syn. فِرْقَةٌ, (T,) or طَايءِفَةٌ, (S,) or جَمَاعَةٌ; (M, K;) of men: (T, M:) [see more in art. فيأ, to which it belongs accord. to some: accord. to others,] it is originally فِيءوَة [app. فِيءْوَةٌ] (T) [or فِيءْوٌ (see art. فيأ); or فِيءْىٌ or فِيءْيَةٌ (see what follows)]; the ة being a substitute for the [final radical letter, which is و or] ى: (S:) the pl. is فِيءُونَ (S, M, K) and فِيءَاتٌ. (M, K.) El-Kumeyt says, تَرَى مِنْهُ جَمَاجِمَهُمْ فِيءِينَا meaning [Thou wouldst see, in consequence thereof, their skulls become] scattered fragments. (S.)
فَأْوَى * The head, or glans, of the penis. (M, K.)
فَايءِيَةٌ * or فَايءِيَّةٌ (accord. to different copies of the K) An elevated, expanded place. (K.)
